set -e
log() { echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')] $1"; }
error() { echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')] ERROR: $1" >&2; exit 1; }

# Configure OpenBao address
OPENBAO_ADDR="http://openbao-rs-manager.openbao.svc.cluster.local:8200"

log "=== Evaluator OpenBao Token Read Test ==="

# Check basic connectivity to OpenBao
log "Testing connectivity to OpenBao at $OPENBAO_ADDR..."
STATUS_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --connect-timeout 5 "$OPENBAO_ADDR/v1/sys/health" 2>&1 || echo "000")

if [ "$STATUS_CODE" = "000" ]; then
  error "Cannot reach OpenBao at $OPENBAO_ADDR (connection failed)"
elif [ "$STATUS_CODE" != "200" ] && [ "$STATUS_CODE" != "429" ] && [ "$STATUS_CODE" != "503" ]; then
  log "⚠ OpenBao returned unexpected status code: $STATUS_CODE"
else
  log "✓ OpenBao is reachable (HTTP $STATUS_CODE)"
fi

# Read Kubernetes service account token for authentication
if [ ! -f "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token" ]; then
  error "Not running in Kubernetes cluster"
fi

SA_TOKEN=$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token)
SA_NS=$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace)
SA_NAME=$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/name)

log "Running as ServiceAccount: $SA_NAME in namespace: $SA_NS"

# Verify we're running as the correct service account
if [ "$SA_NAME" != "seam-retirement-evaluator" ]; then
  log "⚠ WARNING: Not running as seam-retirement-evaluator service account"
  log "  Current SA: $SA_NAME (expected: seam-retirement-evaluator)"
  log "  This test will attempt authentication anyway, but may fail"
else
  log "✓ Running as correct service account: seam-retirement-evaluator"
fi

if [ "$SA_NS" != "seam" ]; then
  log "⚠ WARNING: Not running in seam namespace"
  log "  Current namespace: $SA_NS (expected: seam)"
  log "  This test will attempt authentication anyway, but may fail"
else
  log "✓ Running in correct namespace: seam"
fi

# Authenticate using Kubernetes auth method with evaluator role
log "Authenticating to OpenBao via Kubernetes auth as seam-retirement-evaluator..."
AUTH_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \
  --connect-timeout 5 \
  --data "{\"role\": \"seam-retirement-evaluator\", \"jwt\": \"$SA_TOKEN\"}" \
  "$OPENBAO_ADDR/v1/auth/kubernetes/login" 2>&1)

# Check if authentication succeeded
if echo "$AUTH_RESPONSE" | grep -q "errors"; then
  error "Authentication failed: $AUTH_RESPONSE"
elif ! echo "$AUTH_RESPONSE" | grep -q "client_token"; then
  error "Authentication response missing token: $AUTH_RESPONSE"
fi

# Extract token (masked in logs)
CLIENT_TOKEN=$(echo "$AUTH_RESPONSE" | grep -o '"client_token":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
log "✓ Successfully authenticated to OpenBao as seam-retirement-evaluator (token: ${CLIENT_TOKEN:0:12}...)"

# Read the evaluator's GitHub token
log "Reading GitHub token from secret/evaluators/seam-retirement-evaluator/github-token..."
READ_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X GET \
  -H "X-Vault-Token: $CLIENT_TOKEN" \
  --connect-timeout 5 \
  "$OPENBAO_ADDR/v1/secret/data/evaluators/seam-retirement-evaluator/github-token" 2>&1)

# Check for errors
if echo "$READ_RESPONSE" | grep -qi "permission denied"; then
  error "FAIL: Permission denied reading evaluator's own GitHub token"
elif echo "$READ_RESPONSE" | grep -qi "Invalid"; then
  error "FAIL: Invalid token or path when reading GitHub token"
elif echo "$READ_RESPONSE" | grep -q "errors"; then
  error "FAIL: Error reading GitHub token: $READ_RESPONSE"
elif ! echo "$READ_RESPONSE" | grep -q "data"; then
  error "FAIL: No data in response when reading GitHub token"
fi

# Extract the token value
GITHUB_TOKEN=$(echo "$READ_RESPONSE" | grep -o '"token":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)

if [ -z "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
  error "FAIL: Could not extract token from response"
fi

log "✓ Successfully retrieved GitHub token (length: ${#GITHUB_TOKEN} characters)"

# Validate token format
log "Validating GitHub token format..."

# Check if token is empty
if [ -z "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
  error "FAIL: GitHub token is empty"
fi

# Check if token contains placeholder value
if [ "$GITHUB_TOKEN" = "REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_GITHUB_PAT" ]; then
  error "FAIL: GitHub token contains placeholder value - not yet configured"
fi

# Check if token looks like a GitHub token
if echo "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | grep -q "^ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9_]\{36\}$"; then
  log "✓ Token format valid (GitHub PAT: ghp_ prefix, 36 characters)"
elif echo "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | grep -q "^gho_[a-zA-Z0-9_]\{36\}$"; then
  log "✓ Token format valid (GitHub OAuth token: gho_ prefix, 36 characters)"
elif echo "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | grep -q "^ghu_[a-zA-Z0-9_]\{36\}$"; then
  log "✓ Token format valid (GitHub user token: ghu_ prefix, 36 characters)"
elif echo "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | grep -q "^[a-f0-9]\{40\}$"; then
  log "✓ Token format valid (Legacy GitHub token: 40 hex characters)"
elif echo "$GITHUB_TOKEN" | grep -q "^github_pat_[a-zA-Z0-9_]\{82\}$"; then
  log "✓ Token format valid (Fine-grained PAT: github_pat_ prefix, 82 characters)"
else
  log "⚠ WARNING: Token format doesn't match standard GitHub PAT patterns"
  log "  Token starts with: ${GITHUB_TOKEN:0:10}..."
  log "  This may be a test token or custom format"
fi

# Verify we cannot access SEAM routes (security boundary check)
log "Verifying security boundaries (cannot access SEAM routes)..."
SEAM_TEST=$(curl -s -X GET \
  -H "X-Vault-Token: $CLIENT_TOKEN" \
  --connect-timeout 5 \
  "$OPENBAO_ADDR/v1/secret/data/seam/routes/" 2>&1)

if echo "$SEAM_TEST" | grep -qi "permission denied\|deny"; then
  log "✓ Correctly denied access to SEAM routes"
else
  error "FAIL: Can access SEAM routes - security violation!"
fi

# Verify we cannot access other secret paths
log "Verifying cannot access other secret paths..."
OTHER_TEST=$(curl -s -X GET \
  -H "X-Vault-Token: $CLIENT_TOKEN" \
  --connect-timeout 5 \
  "$OPENBAO_ADDR/v1/secret/data/armor/" 2>&1)

if echo "$OTHER_TEST" | grep -qi "permission denied\|Invalid"; then
  log "✓ Correctly denied access to other secret paths"
else
  error "FAIL: Can access other secret paths - policy too permissive!"
fi

log "=== Evaluator OpenBao Token Read Test Complete ==="
log ""
log "✓ All tests passed:"
log "  - OpenBao connectivity verified"
log "  - Evaluator authentication successful"
log "  - GitHub token retrieved successfully"
log "  - Token format validated"
log "  - Security boundaries verified (cannot access SEAM routes)"
log "  - Policy isolation verified (cannot access other paths)"
log ""
log "The seam-retirement-evaluator role can successfully read its GitHub token."
